Record Class OllamaRunningModel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.ollama.OllamaRunningModel
Record Components:
name - the model identifier name
model - the exact model tag or path
size - the total size in bytes occupied in system RAM/VRAM
sizeVram - the size in bytes occupied specifically in GPU VRAM
contextLength - the active context window allocated for this instance
expiresAt - the timestamp string when Ollama will automatically unload the model from memory
parameterSize - parameter scale string (e.g., "9.0B", "35B")
quantizationLevel - quantization format (e.g., "Q4_K_M", "IQ4_XS")
public record OllamaRunningModel(String name, String model, long size, long sizeVram, Integer contextLength, String expiresAt, String parameterSize, String quantizationLevel) extends Record
Immutable record representing an active model loaded into host memory or GPU VRAM by Ollama.

anahata
